title: Meet the Frequency: QFR Introduces Its Founding Roster
subtitle: Roster Announcement
excerpt: Three artists. Three different frequencies. One independent label built to give every one of them room to grow.
body: Quantum Frequency Records officially welcomes its founding roster: Buckshot Bourbon, Moonflower Radio, and Easton Echo. From Long Island country-rock to progressive psychedelic rock and synth-pop, the roster was never designed to fit neatly inside a genre chart. Each artist brings a different sound, story and creative world to QFR. This is where their stories begin.  QFR is actively finalizing contracts with several additonal artist as well. More to come...
